limitations: Reused development sequences; one observed run per case and arm. No held-out generalization or significance claim.
Absolute ordinary ADD over frozen loader vertex samples including UV-split multiplicities; no alignment, scale fit, GT repair or symmetry minimization.
Five-consecutive-input recovery is a retrospective GT-based metric, not online correctness or identity verification.
Seed-source counts record policy selection, not identity admission or guaranteed neural acceptance.
The two mustard cases share the same original sequence; three cases are not three independent captures.
Accuracy improvement is confined to one occlusion case; both other failure counts stay unchanged and their mean ADD slightly increases.
Pre-loss anchors reduce measured tracking throughput in all three cases.
This package contains numeric summaries and plots only; GT-derived ADD error curves appear in plots, but no raw poses, GT arrays, input images, models, weights or source code.

metric_vertex_representation.explanation: Frozen primary metric uses all mesh-loader vertices, including duplicate coordinates introduced at UV seams. The legacy all_original_CAD_vertices field in source summaries counts loader samples, not raw OBJ unique coordinates.
metric_vertex_representation.sensitivity: Raw OBJ vertex weighting is a subsequent diagnostic and does not replace the preregistered frozen primary result.

raw_OBJ_vertex_row_sensitivity.description: Average every original OBJ vertex row, preserving any duplicates already present in OBJ. This changes loader-induced UV multiplicity for mustard; it does not deduplicate cracker OBJ rows. No pose, threshold, GT, frame denominator or recovery rule changes.

timing_interpretation.FP_load: Measured FP model_setup duration (weights and setup); first run cache state differs from later runs.
timing_interpretation.child: Fresh child validation/import/model load/registration/all inputs/all frames.json journal rewrites/audit/artifact hashing; excludes final report write. Throughput denominator includes frame zero (375/737/185 input slots).
timing_interpretation.first_frontend_call: First input point frontend call includes lazy backend/model startup and actual first inference; not an isolated checkpoint-load measurement.
timing_interpretation.parent: Per-run parent-observed launch-to-child-completion wall time, including model loading, per-frame journals and subprocess overhead. Throughput denominator includes frame zero. Not full six-run experiment duration.
timing_interpretation.point_backend_object_construction: Object construction only; must not be described as complete point-model cold loading.
timing_interpretation.tracking_fps: Tracking inputs only (frame zero excluded) / sum of measured frame wall times; includes synchronized point calls, fitting, support, adaptive FP and frame evidence. Excludes frames.json journal rewrite after EVERY frame, load, registration, first input, final journal rewrite and finalization. This is not end-to-end throughput.
timing_interpretation.warm_cold_caveat: Fresh processes but uncontrolled filesystem/JIT/cache temperature and fixed order; no isolated cold-start benchmark, repeated trial variance, or production FPS claim.

verification.scope: Independent actual metric and event/timing/pairing reviews; status applies to arithmetic and evidence consistency, not object identity or held-out generalization.
